name: fundos
description: FundOS — programmable-money autonomous fund OS (高専拠出 MVP)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fundos/core && npm run build -w @fundos/kosen && npm run build -w @fundos/agent && npm run build -w @fundos/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fundos/core && npm run build -w @fundos/kosen && npm run build -w @fundos/agent && npm run test -w @fundos/core && npm run test -w @fundos/kosen && npm run test -w @fundos/agent
scripts.demo: npm run build -w @fundos/core && npm run build -w @fundos/kosen && npm run demo -w @fundos/agent
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fundos/core && npm run build -w @fundos/kosen && npm run build -w @fundos/agent && npm run dev -w @fundos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fundos/core && npm run typecheck -w @fundos/kosen && npm run typecheck -w @fundos/agent
